name: Castrillo de la Reina (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Castrillo de la Reina (a castle beneath stars on red).
history: Municipal flag of Castrillo de la Reina; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Castrillo de la Reina arms — castle beneath stars
